name: COC Keeper
description: Call of Cthulhu at a real table: the Keeper is the product, seven verbs reach a deterministic kernel, and the module graph is the only authored truth.

ext.coc-keeper.difficulty.title: Creation difficulty
ext.coc-keeper.difficulty.description: Character creation difficulty presets and custom knobs, snapshot into each new campaign (contract §33).

ext.coc-keeper.laneModel.title: Fast model
ext.coc-keeper.laneModel.description: The one quick model every lane that has to be quick runs on: item parameters, reviews, journals, memory, the verifier, voices, projected words, adaptations and prefetched usages (contract §37.10.1). Absent means they follow the table's own model. Read each time a lane runs; a lane's own environment variable still overrides it.

ext.coc-keeper.laneThinking.title: Fast model reasoning effort
ext.coc-keeper.laneThinking.description: The reasoning effort the fast model's tool-running lanes use. Absent means the lane's own level (low), never the table's (contract §37.11). Read each time a lane runs.

ext.coc-keeper.beginnerHints.title: Beginner hints
ext.coc-keeper.beginnerHints.description: Whether a short explanation opens by itself the first time this desk meets a moment a new player may not understand (the guide's first question, the Keeper's opening). Off leaves the "?" buttons and opens nothing.
